Hora de cá. Debaixo de cada jogo, os teu: Local time. Under each game, your players (the lineup in bold). During the games: live score and the numbers of the players in the lineup.
Odds das casas de apostas quando há; sen: Bookmaker odds when there are any; otherwise season averages with form and opponent. Each player’s number (pp) is how much he adds to the day’s win: without him, the best one left would come in. “Saves others”: he’s here so someone better can be kept for another day. The ones left out are saved for other days or are worth less.
Todos os teus jogadores com jogo neste d: All your players with a game this day. Big numbers: last 5 games; small: season. Opp.: how much the opponent allows of this stat. Tap a header to sort and a player to open his card.
Um Moment só joga por uma conta em cada: A Moment only plays for one account each night. Before the night shown, gift the Moment to the other account on Top Shot, then read the wallets again (Players → Collection).
Cada aro é a probabilidade de acabares a: Each ring is the chance of finishing the run with at least that many wins: full means certain. Green likely, yellow a toss-up, red hard. The plan picks the lineups to raise these chances.
A probabilidade de cada total de vitória: The chance of each win total at the end of the run. The colours mark the prize tiers; the outline is the most likely total.
O plano junta as coleções das tuas conta: The plan pools your accounts’ collections as if they were one and picks each account’s lineup. Tap an account to see its prizes.
A previsão de cada dia fica guardada até: Each day’s prediction is saved until the first game. Then you see the prediction next to what happened: wins, totals and each player (100% = did as predicted). With few days, luck weighs a lot.
Os teus dias de Fast Break lidos da bloc: Your Fast Break days read from the blockchain, from every run. Older days come in little by little.
Os teus jogadores nesta run. Usos: quant: Your players in this run. Uses: how many days they can still play (those of the best card: Common 1, Rare 2, Legendary 4; more cards of the same player don’t add up). The strip is the run’s days: used, in the plan, on the other account, has a game. Tap a player to change his uses, cards or status.
O escalão de cada Moment: o site adivinh: The tier of each Moment: the site guesses it from the set and the mint size. If it’s wrong, pick the right one: the other cards of the same set learn from it (yours and the group’s). The player gets the uses of his best card.
Os teus Moments lidos da blockchain (tod: Your Moments read from the blockchain (all accounts), saved in your profile for every run. Uses per run of each player: those of the best card. Moments of players outside this NBA season don’t count.
Os melhores da NBA em cada estatística (: The NBA’s best in each stat (this season mixed with last). % = how often the stat comes up on Fast Break days; ● = it comes up in the rest of this run. Specialist: top of this stat but outside the top 75 scorers. Steady/streaky: how much he varies from game to game.
Média dos últimos 5 jogos face à da époc: Average of the last 5 games vs the season. The bars are the last 5 games (most recent on the right); the line is the season average.
Relatório da ESPN. No plano: fora → não: ESPN report. In the plan: out → doesn’t play; doubtful → 25%; questionable or day-to-day → 50%; probable → 90% (in his next game, and less in the following ones). In the player’s card you can ignore the report. For the rest of the NBA only the important ones show (20+ minutes or 12+ points).
O lineup que o plano de cada um sugere p: The lineup each one’s plan suggests for each day (it changes until the game). Lock: already locked or already playing. Underlined: a player you also have.
Refaz a tua run com Moments dos amigos,: Redoes your run with your friends’ Moments, only on days their plan doesn’t use them. It counts the uses of one of their Moments in a run. On Top Shot they gift you the Moment and you give it back after you play that day.
O grupo vê o lineup que o teu plano suge: The group sees the lineup your plan suggests and your players’ uses, and can ask you for Moments on days you don’t use them. Your roster and plan stay yours.
Até 2 contas extra tuas. O plano junta a: Up to 2 extra accounts of yours. The plan pools the collections and tells you which Moments to send to which account before each night (a Moment only plays for one account each night).
O endereço da tua carteira Dapper: 0x e: Your Dapper wallet address: 0x and 16 letters or numbers (it’s in Dapper and in your Top Shot profile). It’s used to read your Moments and your results from the blockchain.
<b>Jogos seguidos</b>: no 2.º de dois jo: Back-to-backs: in the 2nd of two games on consecutive days, without odds, the plan takes off ~3% (or what that player did in those games last season). Form: without odds, it mixes the season with the last 10 and 5 games (normal: 50/30/20%). The odds already account for both.
Atualizados sozinhos: calendário e média: Updated automatically: schedule and averages in the morning, odds in the afternoon and early evening (Lisbon time), blockchain and injuries every 30 minutes.
